_comment: What each AC showroom gives a lot to work with. Measured off the .kn5 itself, not guessed - run
Modding/Tools/ac_track_tools/kn5bounds.py over the model and paste what --json prints:
floorWidth/Depth is the extent of geometry lying near y = 0: what a car can stand on. wallRadius is
the nearest floor edge to the middle, and the camera is kept inside it - a camera outside the room
renders the back of the wall.
capacity is how many cars stand inside the walls with room to walk round them. In the two 28 m rooms
that is more cars than can be held in one shot; that is fine, the lot is swung round the way it would
be walked. Twenty is the ceiling everywhere, for load time rather than room: twenty models is already
a few hundred MB to read in.
A dealer's stockHigh in dealers.json must stay at or under its showroom's capacity, or the overflow
can only be read about and never looked at.
